source.boundary: Synthetic Preview browser capture only. Existing required registry, fixture, review, quality and release gates remain required. A capture or candidate attestation does not establish receiving acceptance.
source.verifiedSourceBoundary: Exact checkout recorded by workflow candidate-source and its exact-PR-head guard; raw CI environment commit metadata is not treated as checked-out source.

coverage.note: Every new image was individually opened with view_image. Reuse was admitted only after exact image bytes and retained prior review/image hashes were verified, not by inheriting a source-level verdict.

artifact.scope: Review binds extracted files; provider ZIP digest is provenance only.

evidence.imageBindings: Each named PNG independently hash-matched to its exact raw-report test title/case/project PNG body and to retained original report-data bytes. Four contract/input hashes verified against attestation.

rawCiMetadata.meaning: Event merge metadata differs from recorded candidate checkout. No exact-source claim is derived from this environment metadata.

reportedAutomation.note: Report/attestation inspected and outcome fields checked, not independently rerun.

verdict: No blocking visible regression found in the supplied static initial states
nonBlockingObservations: Inherited mobile Tasks-loading PNG width is664 rather than nominal390. It matches retained prior reviewed bytes and is not a new clean-overflow claim.
New Analytics and wide upload-affordance PNGs remain legible; their image changes do not imply a Ping UI or runtime change.
visibleChanges: Six image-byte differences were inspected: Analytics tablet/desktop/wide, Analytics loading desktop/wide and Drive-upload affordance wide. No new blocking layout issue was visible.
Sixty-six images reuse independently inspected exact prior bytes; original review paths and SHA256 evidence are retained per image.
limitations: Synthetic preview screenshots and deterministic component fixtures are not authenticated production receiving, live data or founder acceptance.
No Ping completed-history GET, current membership authorization, model execution, folder creation, Apply/Undo, Drive or Blob provider behavior can be inferred from these materiality stills.
Chat sends, invitations, Project switching, completion/confetti, board/collapse/reorder, retry and other unseen interactions were not independently replayed.
Files uses the known demo surface; Welcome is its known unavailable fallback; upload target shows an affordance rather than a completed upload.
This review does not qualify later Analytics/Shell/Tasks/Notes/H2/Whiteboard/recipe tail source; it binds only the exact Ping candidate and retained evidence files.

The188-outcome run and sidebar success are producer execution evidence. This review independently checks raw hashes/outcomes and images; it does not claim rerunning the cloud browser or independently validating the provider ZIP digest.
